item.title: Hydrangea Season in Wakayama: Blue Blooms in the Rains — Guide
item.description: June, the rainy season, is hydrangea (ajisai) season in Japan, and Wakayama’s shrines, temples and hillside gardens fill with thousands of blooms in shifting blues, purples, pinks and whites. Hydrangeas are the flower of the rains — they look their best when wet, the colours deepening and the heavy heads bowing under raindrops — so this is one of the few times when a grey, drizzly day genuinely improves the view.
